chapter 09 · from my heart to yours

One last thing, my baby.

My dearest Ishika,

I love you so much. I miss you in the smallest moments — when something funny happens, when I hear a song, when I see something beautiful, or when I simply wish you were beside me.

You are my Booboo, my cutie, my babu, my sweetie and my favourite person. I know I can be cheesy (okay, extremely cheesy), but every silly line comes from a very real place in my heart.

I want to keep making memories with you: laughing at silly things, supporting each other, celebrating little wins, and being there on the not-so-easy days too. I hope you never doubt how special you are to me.

If I could choose one person to annoy with my love every day, I'd choose you. Every single time. No refunds, no exchanges. You're stuck with this lovestruck boy. 🥹

Yours, hopelessly and happily ♡
💗

I love you, Ishika.

Now come collect your real-life hug, sweetie. And maybe 847 forehead kisses.
